observation.visible_scene: Extreme close-up of two hands holding and working a tuft of white, fluffy fibrous material against a blurred tan background. The left hand's thumb and fingers pinch one side of the fiber while the right hand's fingers pinch the other side.
visible_changes: The left hand repositions: its thumb and index finger move from a near-vertical pinch at the left edge to a more horizontal grip with both nails facing the camera.
The right hand rotates through the clip, changing from a curled posture with knuckles toward the camera to an extended posture where the index and middle fingernails face the camera.

The white fibrous mass is drawn, stretched and consolidated: loose wisps that project upward in the early frames are pulled in, and the material forms a rounded white ball held between the fingertips of both hands by the later frames.
The ball of fiber shifts position within the frame, moving from the left-center toward the center as the hands adjust their grip.
Small stray fibers extend from the edges of the mass and retract as it is compressed.
outside_clip_unknowns: The identity of the fiber and the purpose of the manipulation are not shown.
What the hands do before the clip starts and after it ends is unknown; the segment begins and ends mid-manipulation.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent drift of the blurred background reflects camera movement or hand movement is not determinable.
The exact material (e.g., cotton, wool, or synthetic batting) cannot be confirmed from the frames.
